items.name: utils
items.title: cn helper
items.description: Tailwind class merge helper used by every PokemonCn component.

items.name: area-banner
items.title: Area Banner
items.description: The HG/SS area-name placard. Wooden plank for towns, leaves+berry for Ilex, stone for caves, water for sea — composed exactly like draw_map_name.c does it. RLE-compressed pixel rectangles rendered as inline SVG, zero asset dependencies, scales to any size with crispEdges.

items.name: type-badge
items.title: Type Badge
items.description: The HG/SS move-type chip (FIRE, WATER, GRASS…). Pixel-perfect, decoded from the LZ77-compressed sprite NARC at files/a/0/0/8 against the master battle palette. 18 standard types. Single-file inline-SVG component — rect data lives next to the JSX, no separate data file, no asset deps.

items.name: hp-bar
items.title: HP Bar
items.description: The HG/SS battle HP gauge. Chamfered pill, ink frame, 2-tone fill that auto-tiers green / yellow / red on value/max ratio. Colours lifted from the actual HP-bar palette (member 0x47 of files/a/0/0/8). Inline SVG, scales to any size, label is your child.

items.name: xp-bar
items.title: XP Bar
items.description: The HG/SS experience strip. Half-height variant of HpBar with the iconic XP blue (palette 0x47, indices 11/12). Inline SVG, scalable, label as children.

items.name: dialogue-box
items.title: Dialogue Box
items.description: The HG/SS speech window — 20 frame styles the player can pick under Options → Frame. Colours sampled from files/a/0/3/8 (NCGR 2..21 + NCLR 26..45). 2px border, 1px inner accent stripe, hard offset shadow, optional ▼ continue cursor. Children are yours.

items.name: menu-list
items.title: Menu List
items.description: Sprite-era selection list — pause menu, battle menu, anywhere a Pokémon game shows a stack of options with a ▶ cursor on the active row. Composable with <MenuItem>, full keyboard nav (↑/↓, Home/End, Enter/Space), hover and focus stay in sync with the cursor.

items.name: status-badge
items.title: Status Badge
items.description: The 24×8 battle status chip — PAR / FRZ / SLP / PSN / BRN. Pixel data and palette lifted from pret/pokeheartgold (battle_hp_bar_data.h tiles 0x29..0x37, palette files/a/0/0/8 member 71). Inline SVG, scales to any size, the 3-letter glyph is part of the sprite.

items.name: poke-ball
items.title: Poké Ball
items.description: Every Poké Ball icon HG/SS ships with — the 16 standard balls plus the Apricorn family (Fast/Level/Lure/Heavy/Love/Friend/Moon/Sport) and Park Ball. 25 variants total, each decoded from its own NCGR + NCLR pair under files/itemtool/itemdata/item_icon. Inline SVG, RLE-compressed rect data, no asset deps.

items.name: apricorn
items.title: Apricorn
items.description: The seven HG/SS Apricorn fruit icons — red, yellow, blue, green, pink, white, black — that Kurt at Azalea Town forges into the eight Apricorn balls. Each variant decoded from its own NCGR + NCLR pair under files/itemtool/itemdata/item_icon (item IDs 485–491). Inline SVG, RLE-compressed rect data, no asset deps.

items.name: stat-hexagon
items.title: Stat Hexagon
items.description: The Gen 5 (B/W) summary-screen radar — six axes for HP/Atk/Def/SpA/SpD/Spe with HP at 12 o'clock, gold polygon over a cool grid. Pure SVG, scales to any size, override fill/stroke for theming, no asset deps.

items.name: gym-badge
items.title: Gym Badge
items.description: All 16 Johto + Kanto gym badges, decoded from files/a/0/4/9 (the Trainer Card NARC). Two display states via the `lit` prop: unlit silver-cream silhouette, or lit in the badge's canonical hue. RLE-compressed inline-SVG, no asset deps.
